environment.browser: headless Chrome, 1280x900, device scale 1, zh-CN, light
environment.remote: a local bare repository behind url.<path>.insteadOf = https://git.example.com/demo/memory.git

webui.space: store gateway created with the Mnemon CLI on Studio, 3 memories, registered as AI Gateway routing
webui.round: MacBook: mnemon recall routing on every space, 立即同步; Studio: the same
webui.fixWriteRounds: each machine remembers one memory with the CLI, then MacBook, Studio and MacBook sync; after two rounds both hold 1 space with 7 memories and 44 links (after refreshing the page)

realCli.harness: harness/real-cli-sync.probe.ts, copied into tests/ as real-cli-sync.spec.ts, MNEMON_CLI_PATH set

readsChange: recall, search, show: insights.access_count, insights.last_accessed_at, oplog rows, sqlite_sequence.seq; forget sets deleted_at and updated_at and removes the memory's edges

limits.largeSpace: 20,000 memories with 768-dimension embeddings and 100,000 edges read in 367 ms
